WITH monthly AS (SELECT st.region, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(s.units_sold) AS units_sold FROM fmcg_sales AS s JOIN dim_store AS st ON s.store_id = st.store_id WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY st.region, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(s.date AS DATE))), lagged AS (SELECT region, month_start, units_sold, LAG(units_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_units_sold FROM monthly) SELECT region, month_start, units_sold, prev_units_sold, (units_sold - prev_units_sold) AS month_on_month_change FROM lagged ORDER BY region, month_start LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly AS (SELECT p.category, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(s.units_sold) AS units FROM fmcg_sales AS s JOIN dim_product AS p ON s.sku = p.sku WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY p.category, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(s.date AS DATE))), month_change AS (SELECT category, month_start, units, LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_units FROM monthly) SELECT category, month_start, units, prev_units, (units - prev_units) AS mom_change FROM month_change WHERE NOT prev_units IS NULL ORDER BY category, month_start LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly AS (SELECT st.channel, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(s.units_sold) AS units_sold FROM fmcg_sales AS s JOIN dim_store AS st ON s.store_id = st.store_id WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY st.channel, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(s.date AS DATE))), lagged AS (SELECT channel, month_start, units_sold, LAG(units_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_units_sold FROM monthly) SELECT channel, month_start, units_sold, prev_units_sold, (units_sold - prev_units_sold) AS month_on_month_change FROM lagged WHERE NOT prev_units_sold IS NULL ORDER BY channel, month_start LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT dim_store.region, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(fmcg_sales.date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(fmcg_sales.units_sold) AS total_units_sold FROM fmcg_sales JOIN dim_store ON fmcg_sales.store_id = dim_store.store_id WHERE fmcg_sales.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY dim_store.region, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(fmcg_sales.date AS DATE))) SELECT region, month_start, AVG(total_units_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_units_sold FROM monthly_sales ORDER BY region, month_start LIMIT 1000

WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT w.region,
           DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) AS week_start,
           SUM(s.units_sold) AS units
    FROM fmcg_sales AS s
    JOIN dim_store AS st ON s.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN weekly_modeling_data AS w ON s.sku = w.sku AND DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) = w.week
    WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31'
    GROUP BY w.region, DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(s.date AS DATE))
),
growth AS (
    SELECT region, week_start, units,
           LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY week_start) AS prev_units
    FROM weekly
)
SELECT region, week_start, units, prev_units,
       (units - prev_units) AS wow_change
FROM growth
WHERE prev_units IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY wow_change DESC
LIMIT 10
